patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with dark earthy backgrounds and lighter card-like content sections, creating a clear visual rhythm down the page.
A strong contrast between a large, elegant serif font for primary headings and a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and UI elements.
A warm, rustic color palette dominated by deep browns, terracotta accents, and light cream surfaces, evoking a natural and historical feel.

The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than the foreground content, while the navigation bar transforms into a sticky, solid bar with a light background upon scroll.
Content sections frequently use a two-column layout, often pairing descriptive text with a relevant image or interactive element like a booking form.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a fixed background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the content layered over it, creating a subtle parallax depth effect. Scroll-triggered animations, likely using GSAP, are employed to reveal subsequent content sections with a fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport. The main navigation bar transitions from a transparent overlay to a solid, slightly condensed bar with a background color and shadow once the user scrolls past the hero section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, impactful serif headings (~4-5x body) with a slightly condensed character, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and UI elements.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (approx. 4-8px) applied consistently to buttons, input fields, and card containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and a comfortable rhythm within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, earthy color palette combined with elegant, slightly condensed serif typography creates a sophisticated and authentic historical ambiance. The full-bleed hero image of the stone structure immediately sets a unique, immersive tone, moving beyond generic travel templates.
